notes: Final WAV files are trimmed, mono 44.1 kHz game-ready edits made from recorded-source files.

Fire samples are based on the selected candidate 01_real_mosin_clean/fire_03.wav: a real Mosin Nagant 7.62x54 mid-distance recording from The Free Firearm Sound Library, then compressed/EQ'd for louder and more present in-game playback.
Bolt/reload cues are split so the viewmodel animation can trigger open, eject, insert, close, and finish sounds separately.
